_comment: Every change to the stock product partition. Paths are inside /product. Built by scripts/build/build_product.py from firmware/original/product.img.

remove.why: Google Cast receiver: ~200 MB RAM, ~9% CPU, opens the mic at 16 kHz first (breaks voice). Disabled on stock with no breakage.
Google Assistant: Device Owner, hotword mic capture, setup flow that needs the dead Lenovo update server.
Google/Lenovo OTA updater: must not overwrite the modified image. Disabled on stock with no breakage.
Assistant home shim; Kiosk Satellite is the only HOME app.
Disabled on first boot since build 2 with no side effects; removed so it no longer appears in Settings.

add.why: Primary interface; updated from GitHub by ClockBridge.
Swipe-up Back/Home/♫ bar, quick panel, settings, tour, media controls (no SystemUI on this firmware). Privileged for MEDIA_CONTENT_CONTROL.
The only persistent app: mic anchor from the start of boot (before HOME). Nothing else, so it rarely changes.
Dock, HA API and pairing, events, gestures, wake-up light, provisioning, Kiosk Satellite and own-app updater. Privileged (SELinux: charge_base), not persistent, so it updates over the network.

add.why: Bluetooth speaker: AVRCP Controller instead of Target, so the phone syncs volume and sends title/artist/controls (no A2DP source on this firmware, so Target had nothing to do).
Microphone/location for ClockBridge and Kiosk Satellite after reset.
First-boot setup config read by ClockBridge.

append_props._why: Appended to /product/build.prop. Non-ro props here override earlier defaults. disableabsvol: a phone's Bluetooth volume steps reached the clock up to ~10 s late (absolute volume handshake); without it the phone scales its own audio, instantly.
